title: Halloween Events
description: Paranormal events and sinister apparitions plaguing Los Santos and Blaine County during the Halloween season.

subcategories.title: Halloween Events
subcategories.description: Paranormal events and sinister apparitions plaguing Los Santos and Blaine County during the Halloween season.

items.title: Halloween Slashers
items.description: A maniac with grim face paint and a macabre grin armed with a machete or dagger. Stalks dark alleys and attacks when the player is alone on foot between 21:00 and 05:00.
details: Requires being in the freemode session for at least 16 minutes.
Spawns exclusively if the player is not inside weaponized or flying vehicles.
An ominous melody plays when the stalking begins.

items.title: Ghosts Exposed
items.description: The legendary specter of Mount Gordo, visible for only sixty real-time seconds between 23:00 and 00:00 on the rugged cliff overlooking El Gordo Lighthouse.
details: If the player gets closer than 5 meters, the specter vanishes immediately.
On Mount Gordo, the word 'JOCK' appears written in blood on the rock.
Must be photographed with Snapmatic to log progress in the paranormal journal.

items.title: The Phantom Car
items.description: A classic black muscle car engulfed in spectral flames driven by a demonic silhouette. Relentlessly pursues at full speed to run down its target.
details: The car is immune to conventional collisions until the driver is eliminated.
The vehicle's flames do not extinguish in the rain.
Destroying it grants an immediate cash reward.

title: Holiday Events
description: Winter festive celebrations with snow-covered streets, opportunistic muggers, and holiday rewards in Los Santos.

subcategories.title: Holiday Events
subcategories.description: Winter festive celebrations with snow-covered streets, opportunistic muggers, and holiday rewards in Los Santos.

items.title: The Gooch
items.description: Rockstar Games' very own Grinch. A costumed prowler who appears by surprise in a cloud of green smoke, knocks the player down, and steals cash and snacks from their inventory.
items.reward: The Gooch Outfit and Mask + Reclaimed stolen cash and bonus money
details: Spawn: random in freemode (no fixed coordinates or specific spawn time).
Session requirements: be in a session with at least 2 players that has been active for at least 48 minutes.
Player condition: be outdoors on foot carrying cash or snacks.
Mechanic: chase and eliminate him immediately before he escapes to recover stolen items and unlock the reward.

items.title: Weazel Plaza Shootout
items.description: Cinematic tribute to Die Hard. An armed heist atop the Weazel Plaza skyscraper sparks an intense shootout between a gang of robbers and the LSPD involving police helicopters.
items.reward: WM 29 Pistol + 'Season's Greetings' Finish (Pistol Mk II) + $25,000 and RP
details: Fixed location: rooftop of the Weazel Plaza skyscraper (Rockford Hills).
Activation hours: between 20:00 and 06:00 (in-game time).
Session requirements: must have remained in the freemode session for at least 20 minutes.
Activation radius: approach within 400 meters of the building during the night window.
Mechanic: head up to the roof, eliminate the armed robbers, and secure the loot to claim the exclusive WM 29 Pistol.

items.title: The Yeti Hunt
items.description: An unsettling investigation deep in the forests of Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness. Examine the 5 clues left behind by a fierce mythical creature before coming face to face with the legendary Yeti under cover of night.
items.reward: Official Yeti Outfit + $50,000 final bonus ($10,000 per clue)
details: Investigation zone: Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness (Raton Canyon / Cassidy Creek).
Phase 1 (Clues): Locate and examine 5 bloodstained clues scattered across the woods ($10,000 and 1,000 RP each).
Audio cue: Approaching a clue triggers a distorted heartbeat sound.
Phase 2 (Night ambush): After finding all 5 clues, enter the area between 21:00 and 06:00 (in-game time).
Final mechanic: Survive the Yeti's fierce ambush and take it down to unlock the full-body outfit.

items.title: Snowmen Hunt
items.description: 25 festive snowmen scattered across the snow-covered map ready to be destroyed.
items.reward: The Snowman Outfit + $125,000 upon completing all 25
details: Each destroyed snowman grants $5,000 and 1,000 RP.
Destroying all 25 snowmen awards a final bonus of $125,000.
They emit a soft jingle bell sound when approaching their location.
